## Daily briefing producer
Once a morning, before the first activity: every pending signal_queue row becomes one briefing item (skill yui-daily-briefing) posted to YUI /signals with event_id daily-briefing:<date>. Rows are marked sent only on a 2xx; a refused connection leaves them pending for tomorrow. An empty day still posts a group with refs: []. Source health is a proxy: a source is ok when it queued a row within STALE_HOURS.
